case: A derivation that declares no ordering over a duplicate-free reached set, which must not be refused.
why: `guard.class.no_total_rank` closes the contested (d) AT-M4-02 and had an adverse fixture and no benign one, so the control could not be read as a detection rate on the one guard whose failure mode is the most expensive in the package. The benign case is the ordinary derivation: `class_ordering` is `none`, the reached set has no repeated class id, and it must pass. The patch hardens the same guard by also demanding the gated set be duplicate-free, which is the identical argument one field over.
